name: authlib
entry_points_source: authlib/jose: JsonWebToken.decode, the validate method of the claims it returns, and the deserialize methods of JsonWebSignature. Entry points are names, so the same names elsewhere in the package count too.
rejection_bases_source: authlib/jose/errors.py: JoseError is the base class of the errors of authlib.jose.
test_directories_source: tox.ini: pytest on tests/core, tests/jose, tests/clients, tests/flask and tests/django, one environment each
suite_runs_source: tox.ini: 1 environment and 1 pytest call for each of tests/core, tests/jose, tests/clients, tests/flask and tests/django
